facts.fact: UNDP's record of the Mais Digit@l programme says UNDP committed a US$3,360,500 grant for 2025-2030, with UNU-EGOV technical assistance and US$566,152 disbursed, to implement the National Digital Transformation Strategy (ENTD.GW), addressing institutional capacity, infrastructure, digital literacy and regulatory frameworks.
